observations.expected: A well-defined multilocular lucent lesion occupies the posterior mandible and ramus.
observations.observed: A large, well-defined multilocular radiolucent lesion is visible in the left posterior mandible and ascending ramus, with scalloped internal septations dividing it into multiple compartments, consistent with a multilocular cystic lesion.

observations.expected: An impacted tooth is associated with the lesion; the remaining visible teeth and jaw are anatomically coherent.
observations.observed: An impacted tooth is visible at the inferior margin of the multilocular lesion in the left posterior mandible. The remaining dentition in both arches appears continuous and seated in alveolar bone with no floating, duplicated, or supernumerary teeth beyond the lesion region. The mandible has two symmetric rami and condyles. The overall dental arch is coherent and age-appropriate for a skeletally mature adult.
